title: Mail Volume Halved While Stamp Prices Rose
hook: Mail fell to 109 billion pieces while stamps got pricier.
closing: Fewer letters leave postal costs spread across fewer customers, keeping prices under pressure.
question: What do you still send by mail?

segments.say: Total mail fell to 109 billion pieces, leaving the network with nearly half its former traffic.
First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces, showing letters disappeared faster than the postal network could shrink.
A stamp reached 68 cents, so falling demand did not make sending a letter cheaper.
